Flow.description: Sets needs geocoding = true whenever an address is updated on the account to trigger the geocoding flow. Account_After_Save_Update_Geocode_and_District
Flow.label: Account | Needs Geocoding True

start.filterFormula: AND( OR( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.PersonMailingAddress})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.BillingAddress})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.ShippingAddress})) ), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.PersonMailingStreet}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.PersonMailingCity}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.PersonMailingState}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.PersonMailingPostalCode}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.BillingStreet}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.BillingCity}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.BillingState}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.BillingPostalCode}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.ShippingStreet}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.ShippingCity}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.ShippingState}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.ShippingPostalCode}) ) )
